title: cymbachne guineensis
intro: Cymbachne guineensis, commonly known as Guinea grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cymbachne guineensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties.
